title: 苍蝇找到的凶手
title_en: The Flies That Found the Killer
blurb_en: A man is murdered on a country road. Seventy villagers, seventy sickles, and one clue that only flies can see.
blurb_zh: 一个人死在乡间小路上。七十个村民，七十把镰刀，还有一个只有苍蝇看得见的线索。
